description: SeedQueue inspired wall for Minecraft pre 1.3 RSG: background world generation with an in-game wall and spawn previews. Fabric (Ornithe). Not yet approved for submitted runs.

mods.name: Queue Wall
mods.description: Generates worlds in the background and shows them on an in-game wall, for 1.0 random seed resetting.

releases.notes:
Queue Wall 0.6.1

Fixed running out of memory with a high Background worlds setting. Each queued world takes about 45 MB, so Background worlds is now capped at what fits in the memory you give Minecraft (21 with 2 GB on a 2x2 wall, the full 32 from 3 GB+). The settings page shows the limit, and the queue makes fewer background worlds if you lock a lot of worlds.

Faster world generation.
- Generator threads now populate chunks (trees, ores, lakes, animals) at the same time, instead of taking turns. More generator threads now actually use more of your CPU and are not bottlenecked.
- Worlds are unchanged, every queued world is still block for block identical to Create New World, checked on 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2.5.

releases.notes:
Queue Wall 0.6.0

In-game settings: Options on the title screen now has a book button in the top right that opens Queue Wall Settings, a scrolling list like the world list. Changes save when you press Done and apply the next time the wall opens. Rows, columns and the locked area still need a restart.

Settings reload: edits to queuewall.properties also apply the next time the wall opens, no restart needed.

No more reset spam on loading worlds: Y only resets a world once its preview shows. Turn on “Reset loading worlds” for the old behaviour.

One play key: the second play key is gone. Rebind the play key if you want a different one.

Locked area height removed: the locked area is always a quarter of the screen.

The hint bar mentions Shift+click when Shift+click to lock is on.
